response.description: An architecture-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures recommender behavior through a stable DiagnosisProbe interface and turns measured results into an interpretation prompt.
response.motivation: Keep diagnosis compatible with model changes while grounding proposed improvements in observed training behavior and the shared macro-average validation HR@10 objective.
response.implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Return metrics alongside explicit metric_definitions, including measurement scope and limitations. Access the trained network through view.model and adapt feature, embedding, and scoring probes to its architecture. Training batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L; exclude padding from measurements. Use only public interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Mark unavailable attributes and simulator diversity/conformity traits as unobserved. Preserve all four dataset routes and generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for five real training users per category. Select models using the pinned macro validation HR@10; diagnostic proxies must not replace it. Keep DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], artifacts within the trial directory, and predictor generation synchronized with architecture changes.
response.pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            inspect valid sequence positions and architecture-compatible scores
            compute supported diagnostic measurements
            record definitions, sample counts, and unavailable measurements
        restore model training state
        return {metrics, metric_definitions}

def diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    format measured metrics with their definitions and limitations
    request evidence-grounded interpretations and testable improvements
    explicitly identify unobserved attributes
    return prompt

originality.positive: Combines a stable diagnostic contract with architecture-aware probes and grounded interpretation.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration specification; no new diagnostic algorithm or empirical novelty is established.

future_potential.positive: Could support repeatable diagnosis and targeted model revisions across architectures.
future_potential.negative: Benefits depend on probe quality and whether suggested changes improve independent validation HR@10.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces and batch structure are explicit.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture adaptation, correct masking, full-catalog scoring, and predictor consistency require care.
